stories.title: Border Patrol finds 14 migrants hidden behind false wall in trailer at Falfurrias checkpoint
stories.summary: Agents said a nervous driver and the smell of marijuana led to the discovery. The driver now faces human smuggling charges.

stories.title: A suspect stole an ATM from a bank in Dallas overnight using a forklift as a getaway vehicle
stories.summary: Dallas police say the burglary occurred around 3:30 a.m. and the investigation is ongoing.

stories.title: East Texas native, Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes, wife reveal gender of 4th child
stories.summary: The Mahomes family revealed the gender of baby number 4 at a gender reveal party on Tuesday.

stories.title: Ballet San Antonio's 'The Nutcracker' returning to the Tobin Center for 41st season
stories.summary: The performances are scheduled for Dec. 4-6 and Dec. 11-13 in the H-E-B Performance Hall.

stories.title: One in three Texas students leaves college without a degree, the study says
stories.summary: In the last five years, those who left college and didn’t return within a year accumulated a total of about $1 billion in student debt.

stories.title: Meet the four finalists for this year's Lombardi Award
stories.summary: The Lombardi Award Ceremony is here in Houston next month and KHOU 11 will stream it live!

stories.title: Amber Alert discontinued for 12-year-old girl
stories.summary: Her last sighting was on North Grosenbacher Road on Tuesday.

stories.title: Proposal for more transparency in San Antonio Police interactions with ICE to be heard by committee Wednesday
stories.summary: San Antonio officials set to discuss a proposal by Councilman Jalen McKee-Rodriguez to increase transparency on how police collaborate with ICE.

stories.title: Texas bills could help cities lower neighborhood speed limits to 20 mph

stories.title: Healthy SA: Being thankful for your health this Thanksgiving
stories.summary: There are many hazards around the house as we prepare to give thanks next week.

stories.title: San Antonio man indicted for wire fraud, posing as veteran contracting officer in $1.6M scheme, court documents show

stories.title: Man accused of killing San Antonio father faces court as family seeks justice
